facts: Shadow mode only: judgments are logged, never used to filter, rerank, or gate expansion.
Flag off (JEV_SHADOW_ENABLED=false) means the Jev client is never constructed and results are byte-identical.
Any Jev error or timeout degrades to a per-candidate skip; search must never fail because of Jev.
No numeric, date, or counting questions go to Jev; question state is text plus scores only.
Thresholds are named constants tuned from measured data only; no hardcoded probability cut.
@typesafe-ai/sdk 0.6.0 exports: TypeSafeClient, noul, choice, score (score aliased from score$1), plus error classes APIError, APIConnectionError, APITimeoutError, TypeSafeError.

new TypeSafeClient(config?: TypeSafeClientConfig) with optional { apiKey?: string, baseURL?: string, defaultModel?: string, timeout?: number, fetch?: Fetch, retry?: Partial<RetryPolicy>, logLevel?, logger? }; apiKey falls back to TYPESAFE_API_KEY env var; baseURL defaults to https://api.typesafe.ai; defaultModel defaults to jev-latest; constructor throws TypeSafeError if the key is missing.

client.systemOne(request, options?) where request = { state: EntryType (string | object | array | null), questions: { [name]: Question }, model?: string }; options = { timeout?: number (ms per attempt), signal?: AbortSignal, retry?, headers? }.
systemOne returns APIPromise<SystemOneResult<Q>> which resolves to { model: string, answers: { [K in keyof Q]: ResultFor<Q[K]> }, usage: { input_tokens: number, output_tokens: number } }.
NoulResponse = { type: 'noul', noul: number } where noul is P(yes) in [0,1]; NoulResponse has no confidence field.
noul(instructions?: EntryType, criteria?: { true?: EntryType, false?: EntryType }) builds a NoulQuestion; import { TypeSafeClient, noul } from '@typesafe-ai/sdk'.
One systemOne request answers ALL named questions against the same state: three noul questions named relevant, evidence, contradicts in one request is the intended call shape.
Errors to catch for fail-open: TypeSafeError (base), APIError (has .status), APIConnectionError, APITimeoutError (has .timeoutMs, extends APIConnectionError), APIUserAbortError.
The worker cannot run npm/node or inspect node_modules: add '@typesafe-ai/sdk' to package.json dependencies only as documented in the brief; the caller installs and verifies.
